Everything you need
 
Grow your list and revenue, all in one place
 
From your earliest subscription forms up to complex automation sequences, our dashboard supplies the exact features needed to convert casual readers into paying buyers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Drag & Drop Builder
 
Shape stunning, mobile-responsive layouts within minutes using a completely visual editor. Code skills are never necessary here.
 
 
 
 
 
Smart Automation
 
Set up warm welcome triggers and drip sequences that run on autopilot while your team handles main business tasks.
 
 
 
 
 
Real-Time Analytics
 
Monitor campaign opens, link clicks, and address bounces as they happen to scale up successful content paths.
 
 
 
 
 
High Deliverability
 
Land safely inside primary inbox tabs rather than getting lost in spam folders due to our clean mail server infrastructure.
 
 
 
 
 
100+ Templates
 
Launch campaigns fast with pre-made structural layouts tailored for any modern industry niche or special seasonal event.
 
 
 
 
 
GeoTracking
 
Pinpoint exactly where your global readers sit whenever they interact with your outgoing content streams.

Build Beautiful Emails and Custom Landing Pages in Minutes
 
Our styled layout archives contain the raw structural blocks and visual pieces required to publish clean, responsive marketing campaigns without delay.
Choose from our massive library containing over a hundred design styles built for diverse commercial themes. Drop your text and product images straight into the robust layout editor.
The final dashboard view delivers sharp, professional outputs that adjust to look perfect on small phone screens, tablet computers, or wide office desktops.

View Templates
 
 
 
 
Monitor Real-Time Reports and Create Better Campaigns
 
Track the success of your email campaigns with our 
Real-Time Reports
.
Measure the financial success of your email marketing strategy by tracking your instant performance logs. Follow audience clicks, identify which specific servers rejected your message, and tweak your setup instantly.
Our localized tracking layer helps your marketing team understand exactly where your subscribers reside across the globe.

High Inbox Email Delivery
 
When your business wants to avoid getting buried in user junk folders, maintaining a strong sender reputation becomes vital.
Email marketing services by SpiceSend operate as a top-tier delivery system built to help your store hit high conversion metrics along with better open ratios.
No matter if you run a digital agency or a large company , our system helps you send a high number of emails directly to the main inbox. It reduces the chance of your emails going to spam. Try email marketing tool today.

Prepaid Email Credits
 
Skip monthly recurring bills entirely and buy individual message allocations as your brand requires them through our flexible credit plan. Infrequent senders benefit most from this pay-as-you-go route. 
Select volume options ranging across 10,000, 50,000, 100,000, 250,000, or 500,000 messages. Pricing starts at $49 with zero expiration deadlines attached. Launch a free trial today. These on-demand credits carry identical premium tool features as our Professional tier.

Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
Do I have to enter my credit card details to sign up?
 
Registration remains completely card-free. Our system merely requires your name, organizational title, and email address to let you launch your initial broadcasts.
 
 
 
What types of payment do you accept?
 
Our platform processes Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and PayPal. Yearly subscription orders can also be cleared via standard bank wire transfers or paper checks.
 
 
 
Can I try SpiceSend before purchasing a plan?
 
Testing the software costs nothing. Every profile opens on a permanent complimentary tier, letting your team dispatch 200 messages monthly to a cap of 200 contacts.
 
 
 
How do I switch to a different email marketing plan?
 
You can adjust your tier at any time from the secure billing dashboard in your profile. Choose your new capacity level to apply the system upgrades instantly.
 
 
 
Do I need any prior knowledge or skills?
 
Prior design experience is unnecessary. Our application relies on a highly intuitive panel layout so you can 
construct beautiful layouts
, 
sort directories
, and manage advanced settings easily.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Powerful Features, Optimum Pricing
 
Expand your user database, drive subscriber interactions, and compile fresh lead lists under highly competitive rates. Our low-cost platform adapts to your custom corporate needs, packing expert customer care along with modern lead generation software across every single package.
 
Pick your tier and start shaping stunning promotional updates right away.
